name: Multiple Sclerosis
definition: Immune-mediated inflammatory demyelinating disease of the central nervous system characterized by lesions disseminated in time and space.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis uses clinical pattern, MRI and sometimes CSF.
investigations.MRI: MRI brain and spinal cord is central to diagnosis and monitoring.

amber: Immunotherapy requires infection, vaccination, pregnancy and laboratory monitoring.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-vyadhi neurological phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Immune-mediated inflammatory demyelinating disease of the central nervous system characterized by lesions disseminated in time and space.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
